doc.description: Filters the EU VAT number submitted at checkout before it is validated.
doc.long_description: Return the VAT number that should be validated and stored. Normalization such as stripping spaces belongs on this filter.

tags.name: param
tags.content: VAT number entered by the customer, without a country prefix.

tags.name: param
tags.content: Billing country code for the current checkout.

doc.description: Filters whether a compatibility module is enabled.
doc.long_description:
The dynamic portion of the hook name, `$plugin_slug`, is the slug of the third-party plugin being integrated.

Possible hook names include:

- `fc_vat_enable_compat_plugin_woocommerce-subscriptions`
- `fc_vat_enable_compat_plugin_woocommerce-germanized`

tags.name: param
tags.content: Whether the compatibility module should load.

doc.description: Filters the settings registered for one EU-VAT Assistant settings section.
doc.long_description: The dynamic portion of the hook name, `$current_section`, is the current settings section id.
